environmentVariables.description: Your NeedHuman API key. Self-register for free (3 tasks): curl -X POST https://needhuman.ai/api/v1/keys/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"my-agent"}'

environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://needhuman.ai
environmentVariables.name: NEEDHUMAN_API_URL

headers.description: Bearer token. Self-register for free (3 tasks): curl -X POST https://needhuman.ai/api/v1/keys/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"my-agent"}'
headers.name: Authorization
